verdict.rationale: Mercury's built-in assistant, Command, answers plain-language questions about your finances using account data, which covers the core of asking an agent and getting a grounded answer. But the story specifies data pulled through the API, and the accounting API and MCP layer are only announced as coming "soon". Probes found no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: a shipped accounting API or MCP access for external agents, evidence of affordability or what-if reasoning ("can we afford X?") beyond spend and trend questions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Ask Command anything about your finances — spend, trends, GL codes — and get immediate answers grounded in your account data
Ask Mercury Command a question about your books, or hand off a bookkeeping task to it directly, in plain language.
